name: Sunray Savannah 300K 3 Person  Infrared Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Savannah 3-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna is constructed of Canadian red cedar for durability and a natural aroma. The spacious cabin is equipped with 8 carbon nano-heaters that evenly distribute heat up to 140°F. Standard features include dual interior and exterior keypads, a Bluetooth speaker system, movable ergonomic backrests, chromatherapy lighting, oxygen ionization system, and both interior and exterior lighting.
